body.en: Cross-cutting tools used by every service: identity (KernID, Dyon), training (MetaX Academy), self-training agents (SelfAI), publishing (WebBooks).
body.fr: Outils transversaux utilisés par chaque service : identité (KernID, Dyon), formation (MetaX Academy), agents d’autoformation (SelfAI), publication (WebBooks).
